newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks see-saw, end down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks see-saw, end down on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks moved both ways to end down on Monday, mainly on profit-taking by speculators on clearing day. Dealers said they expected the market to remain under pressure in the near term.

"The index moved both ways on speculative activity. People booked profits on settlement day," dealer Sajad Mankani said. "Profit-taking is likely to keep the index under pressure for next couple of sessions." The Karachi 100-share index fell 7.11 points, or 0.49 percent, to end at 1,433.65 amid 101 losers and 75 gainers. PTCL fell 0.35 rupees to 28.20 and Hub Power 0.65 to 36.35. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
